role: String catalog localizing the watch Info.plist purpose strings.
toplevel: sourceLanguage en. CFBundleDisplayName and CFBundleName have only English (state new; CFBundleName 'EmuquWatch Watch App' comes from the generated plist). NSBluetoothAlways/NSHealthShare/NSHealthUpdate UsageDescription have all 17 localizations; English values equal the watch Info.plist strings, and each locale's Bluetooth string says live heart rate shows on the Watch out of range while heartbeats reach the iPhone's recording only in range. Included in the watch bundle through the file-system-synchronized group. The CFBundleName entry is Xcode's extraction of the CFBundleName that GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE injects from PRODUCT_NAME, marked shouldTranslate false.
